hypothesis: If we provide users scrolling to reviews with a verified buyer photo highlight, then they will provides immediate visual proof of actual product quality., because resolves the 'is quality good' uncertainty visually., resulting in an increase in 30-Day Wishlist-to-Purchase User Conversion Rate.
treatment: Surfaces user-uploaded photos to the top of the wishlist item page.
primary_metric: 30-Day Wishlist-to-Purchase User Conversion Rate (Numerator: users who purchase >=1 wishlisted item in 30d. Denominator: users who add >=1 item to wishlist).
guardrail_metrics: Return rate (ensure we aren't driving bad purchases)
expected_direction: Increase in primary metric. No significant increase in return rate.

decision_criteria.ship: Statistically significant increase in primary metric AND neutral/positive guardrails.
decision_criteria.iterate: Trending positive primary metric BUT negative impact on return rates.

timing_strategy: Triggered when user revisits the wishlist or dwells on the Product Detail Page of a wishlisted item. Timing matters to catch them in the decision phase, not the initial bookmarking phase.
